glosses: to take back (after having lost), to retake

forms.form:
te zullen terugnemen
terug te zullen nemen

glosses: een voorwerp opnieuw in bezit terugontvangen

examples.text: De winkelier weigerde de beschadigde goederen terug te nemen.

glosses: terugkomen op en/of zich excuseren voor een eerder gedane uitspraak

examples.text: Goed, dan neem ik dat terug.

translations.source_sense_description: een voorwerp opnieuw in bezit terugontvangen

glosses: To retract or withdraw (an earlier statement).

examples.text: No, you are not fat; I take it all back.

glosses: To cause (someone) to remember some past event or time.

examples.text: That tune takes me back to my childhood.
She has forgiven him, and taken him back.
The wedding is off, and he has taken back the ring.
The Queer community took back the word from their disparagers.

glosses: To return (something) to a vendor for a refund.

examples.text: Take back faulty goods to the shop where you bought them.

translations.source_sense_description: een voorwerp opnieuw in bezit terugontvangen

glosses: To capture or occupy somewhere again.

examples.text: The army tried repeatedly to retake the fort they had been driven from.

glosses: a scene that is filmed again, or a picture that is photographed again
an instance of resitting an examination
